g.text: Pure game logic called by the authoritative server
tetrisd owns the room mutex and all game state.
libtetrisbrain performs no I/O and stores no state.
MOVE / ROTATE / SOFT DROP / gravity tick
Call movement, rotation, or drop function
MOVE commits only a valid candidate.
then tetrisd enters the lock phase directly.
Bake four piece cells into board
Remove full rows and compact downward
